kind: Frozen Native reference checker: actual Bun JSC main-thread attribution and time-free operation census

sampling.kind: Bun JavaScriptCore actual synchronous Native reference checker attribution
sampling.limitation: One profile span encloses the seventeen original sync evaluations, plus their closed scheduling loop and readonly fact-stat snapshots; controls/clones/assertions are excluded. Sampling attribution can include host transport waits; samples are not exclusive CPU work or Blacksmith wall performance. Explicit Atomics.wait frames are reported separately. Source IDs resolve through the raw source table. Inlined and anonymous frames remain in raw evidence.

sourceResolvedAttribution.kind: Source-resolved JavaScriptCore attribution of existing Native reference main work
sourceResolvedAttribution.limitation: The 17 saved sample015 executions are a hotspot probe, not a full-dataset performance result. Native dependency/builtin work is charged to its nearest selected main-source frame. Host wait samples are neither active JS CPU work nor Blacksmith elapsed-time evidence. Group shares overlap and must not be added.

operationCensus.kind: Time-free Native reference main-thread operation census; exact source-local counter replay
operationCensus.limitation: Only source-local closed numeric counters and readonly evidence exports are added in isolated copies. The profiler uses untouched production instead. Counts are actual main Native loop/body visits; native geometry dependencies and worker calculations are not instrumented. Counts do not imply elapsed-time or speed improvement.

findings.interpretation: The current probe attributes substantial remaining main work to recursive interning snapshots and complete finite/plain context validation. It establishes candidates for exact work reduction; it is not an elapsed-time or full-dataset speed result.

limitations: All seventeen captures belong to sample015 and retain one private warm memo. They do not represent all sixteen SRJ18 samples.
The JSC profiler sampled one synchronous production span without wrapping Native checker methods. Controls, cloning, deep assertions and evidence export were outside the span.
Sampling includes Native library/builtin execution and occasional host transport waits. Inclusive groups overlap; nearest-main-source attribution is a separate exclusive partition.

The census runs isolated coherent source copies with closed numeric counters and readonly state exports. It validates whole errors, source aliases, post-circuit state, primitive FIFO/IDs/counters, scaled polygons and physical connectivity against coherent Native control copies.
The first attempted repeated-stop JSC profile is excluded: the pinned runtime produced no samples after early spans. Only the single-span raw profile is durable evidence.
